source: The ONE Thing — Gary Keller & Jay Papasan
note: Motivational quotes drawn verbatim from The ONE Thing, tagged so the app can surface the right line at the right moment. theme = topical bucket; useWhen = app-moment triggers that map to existing signals (new goal, plan confirm, daily open, task done, streak, missed day, behind pace, comeback).

quotes.text: Be like a postage stamp — stick to one thing until you get there.
quotes.author: Josh Billings

quotes.text: If you chase two rabbits, you will not catch either one.
quotes.author: Russian proverb

quotes.text: It is those who concentrate on but one thing at a time who advance in this world.
quotes.author: Og Mandino

quotes.text: There can only be one most important thing. Many things may be important, but only one can be the most important.
quotes.author: Ross Garber

quotes.text: You must be single-minded. Drive for the one thing on which you have decided.
quotes.author: General George S. Patton

quotes.text: Success demands singleness of purpose.
quotes.author: Vince Lombardi

quotes.text: Put all your eggs in one basket, and then watch that basket.
quotes.author: Andrew Carnegie

quotes.text: The secret of getting ahead is getting started. The secret to getting started is breaking your complex overwhelming tasks into small manageable tasks and then starting on the first one.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.text: To get through the hardest journey we need take only one step at a time, but we must keep on stepping.
quotes.author: Chinese proverb

quotes.text: Judge a man by his questions rather than his answers.
quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.text: A prudent question is one-half of wisdom.
quotes.author: Sir Francis Bacon

quotes.text: The power to question is the basis of all human progress.
quotes.author: Indira Gandhi

quotes.text: But those Woulda-Coulda-Shouldas all ran away and hid from one little Did.
quotes.author: Shel Silverstein

quotes.text: When you think about focusing, you think, 'Well, focusing is saying yes.' No! Focusing is about saying no.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.text: Focus is a matter of deciding what things you're not going to do.
quotes.author: John Carmack

quotes.text: One-half of knowing what you want is knowing what you must give up before you get it.
quotes.author: Sidney Howard

quotes.text: Success is simple. Do what's right, the right way, at the right time.
quotes.author: Arnold H. Glasow

quotes.text: People do not decide their futures, they decide their habits and their habits decide their futures.
quotes.author: F. M. Alexander

quotes.text: Things which matter most must never be at the mercy of things which matter least.
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.text: We are kept from our goal, not by obstacles but by a clear path to a lesser goal.
quotes.author: Robert Brault

quotes.text: Planning is bringing the future into the present so that you can do something about it now.
quotes.author: Alan Lakein

quotes.text: Efficiency is doing the thing right. Effectiveness is doing the right thing.
quotes.author: Peter Drucker

quotes.text: Multitasking is merely the opportunity to screw up more than one thing at a time.
quotes.author: Steve Uzzell

quotes.text: Only those who will risk going too far can possibly find out how far one can go.
quotes.author: T. S. Eliot

quotes.text: Purpose without priority is powerless.
quotes.author: Gary Keller & Jay Papasan

quotes.text: Connect today to all your tomorrows. It matters.
quotes.author: Gary Keller & Jay Papasan

quotes.text: A new answer usually requires new behavior.
quotes.author: Gary Keller & Jay Papasan

quotes.text: If you want extraordinary results, look for the levered action that will start a domino run.
quotes.author: Gary Keller & Jay Papasan

quotes.text: Until my ONE Thing is done — everything else is a distraction.
quotes.author: Gary Keller & Jay Papasan

quotes.text: Success is built sequentially. It's one thing at a time.
quotes.author: Gary Keller & Jay Papasan
